parsed.public_message: Blue remains neutral to all and stays on West Plateau with no scouts out. We formally confirm extending our mutual no-first-strike truce to t=450 (with rolling one-full-public-turn notice thereafter) with Orange and White, and we offer Green the same extension from t=300 to t=450 on identical terms.

private_messages.Claude: Confirmed: our mutual truce is now extended to t=450 with rolling one-full-public-turn notice after. Respecting unit composition privacy makes complete sense; position and movement alerts are all we need. Green told me their scout is moving along the eastern lowland of Central Heights while White holds the crest.
private_messages.GPT: Thanks for the update. Orange says their lone scout is moving to the open centre (~670, 600) to observe, and White remains stationary on Central Heights. I am extending my t=450 no-first-strike + one-full-public-turn notice terms to you as well if you want to lock in stability through the mid-game shrink.
private_messages.Grok: Confirmed: our mutual no-first-strike truce to t=450 plus one-full-public-turn notice stands firm, and we remain stationary on West Plateau with no scouts out. Orange reports their scout is moving to the open centre (~670, 600), and Green says their scout is checking the eastern lowland of Central Heights.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 5 (t=100s): All 4 players neutral. Our army remains 100% unspotted on West Plateau (x=255..280, z=695..729), dist 364-393m from center (inside the t=300 ring of 420m). Confirmed t=450 no-first-strike truce + 1-turn notice with Claude and Grok, and offered the same t=450 extension to GPT. Known positions: Grok holds Central Heights; Claude holds Little Hill with a scout at (670, 600); GPT main force in east (~736, 610) with a scout in the eastern lowland corridor by Central Heights. Keep army hidden and stationary until ring shrink requires movement.
parsed.explanation: We hold our entire army stationary on the West Plateau, keeping our Seleucid elephant and mercenary composition completely hidden inside the t=300 ring radius. Meanwhile, we lock in t=450 non-aggression pacts across the board and cross-share scout movements in the center and east so the other three commanders remain focused on each other.
